outcome: ZIKV in maternal-fetal interface (MFI) tissues and fluids
ZIKV in fetal tissues and fluids
Timing of ZIKV infection in MFI and fetus
Route of ZIKV vertical transmission (transplacental vs. paraplacental)
cohort: 12 pregnant rhesus macaques (Macaca mulatta) inoculated with ZIKV at gestational day 30.
finding: ZIKV can reach the maternal-fetal interface by six days and infect the fetus by ten days post-maternal infection, with infection of the chorionic membrane and extraembryonic coelomic fluid preceding fetal infection, suggesting paraplacental vertical transmission through the chorionic membrane.
gest_age: Gestational day 30 at inoculation (term is 165 days)
